design: 16 quarterly forward folds 2022Q1-2025Q4. Fixed 73-source full 15:30 ridge specification; no shrinkage or feature selection.
inner_validation: Immediately preceding complete calendar quarter; tune on all earlier update history from 2021. Example 2022Q1 fits Jan-Sep 2021, validates Q4 2021.
outer_refit: All update history from 2021 through immediately preceding quarter, never the evaluation quarter.
sample_keys: Saved in actual fitting order, with source panel hash. Reservoir sampling on ordered input with one DuckDB thread and fixed fold seeds.
objective: Validation reconstructed log RMSE after tuning-training-derived bounds; exact ties prefer smaller penalty in grid order.
preprocessing: Relearn transforms, clipping, missingness, scaling and encoding on tuning or refit sample only.
target: log1p(auction shares)-log1p(saved annual out-of-time daily anchor)
daily_anchor: Unchanged annually fitted saved daily LightGBM forecasts, not quarterly daily retraining. Lags continue updating through each quarter.
bounds: Relearn 0.1/99.9 percentiles of historical refit log volume; missing checkpoint uses exact daily anchor.
training_universe: Same regular-session and checkpoint-available policy as experiment 19; full regular-session evaluation with exact fallback.
comparisons: Primary quarterly intraday versus daily. Secondary quarterly versus original annual intraday; changed samples/windows/bounds mean this does not isolate refit frequency alone.
reporting: Quarterly, annual and equal-year 2022-2024 development / 2025 previously inspected confirmation; fixed event and liquidity subgroup reports.
uncertainty: 5000 circular date-block replicates within years, 20-date primary, 5/60 sensitivity; directly recompute annual RMSE/WAPE/bias then equal-year means. Conditional on fitted quarterly forecasts, not complete refitting or selection uncertainty.
limits: All evaluation years have been inspected. Nested historical tuning improves procedure audit but does not create a new holdout. No shrinkage calibration stage, new data, automated promotion or quarterly-independent significance test.
